# HomeShield Property Insurance AI Copilot

## 1. Project Overview

HomeShield Property Insurance AI Copilot is a capstone project that demonstrates an Agentic RAG-based assistant for home insurance policy Q&A, peril/exclusion reasoning, claim guidance, memory-aware conversations, and indicative repair-cost estimation.

The assistant uses HomeShield synthetic insurance documents and a repair cost dataset to answer user questions with grounded context.

This project supports:

- Standard policy Q&A
- Comprehensive policy Q&A
- Landlord Plus policy Q&A
- Perils and exclusions lookup
- Insurance glossary explanation
- Damage repair-cost estimation
- Claim status simulation
- Session memory
- Guardrails for safe insurance responses
